slide1.headline: EU AI Act's Draft Code of Practice
slide1.subtitle: What providers and deployers need to know

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: The EU AI Act’s draft Code of Practice on marking and labelling of AI-generated content was released on 24 Mar 2026
This code of practice aims to provide guidance on the marking and labelling of AI-generated content
It will impact providers and deployers of AI-generated content
The exact details of the code are not yet available

slide3.title: WHY IT MATTERS
lines: This code of practice will help to increase transparency and trust in AI-generated content
It will also help to prevent the spread of misinformation
Questions to consider: What are the implications of this code of practice for AI developers?
How will it impact the use of AI-generated content in different industries?
Source: Kennedys Law LLP, 24 Mar 2026

slide1.headline: Interloom Raises $16.5 Million in VC Funding
slide1.subtitle: Exclusive: Interloom, which wants to solve AI agents' 'tacit knowledge' problem, raises $16.5 million in VC funding

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: Interloom raised $16.5 million in VC funding on 23 Mar 2026
This funding will be used to solve AI agents' 'tacit knowledge' problem
Interloom aims to improve the ability of AI agents to understand and apply tacit knowledge
The funding round was led by a group of investors

slide3.title: WHY IT MATTERS
lines: This funding will help Interloom to develop its technology and improve the ability of AI agents to understand and apply tacit knowledge
It will also help to increase the adoption of AI agents in different industries
The funding round is a significant milestone for Interloom and demonstrates the potential of its technology

slide4.title: INSIGHTS
bullets: The funding round was led by a group of investors
Interloom aims to improve the ability of AI agents to understand and apply tacit knowledge
The company plans to use the funding to develop its technology and increase its market presence
